products.title: Al Capone Duck
products.description: Meet the boss of the bathtub. With his sharp suit, signature hat and no-nonsense attitude, Al Capone rules the bubbles. A loyal companion for your next debugging session.

products.title: Bat Duck
products.description: The bathtub needs a hero. Bat Duck keeps watch over the bubbles and helps you hunt down bugs after dark. His greatest weakness? An empty bath.

products.title: Beer Duck
products.description: Clock out and float away. Beer Duck brings a relaxed attitude to your desk and patiently listens while you explain why your code worked yesterday.

products.title: Chef Duck
products.description: Something good is cooking. Chef Duck serves up fresh ideas and helps you follow the recipe for cleaner code. Just keep the spaghetti in the kitchen.

products.title: Dala Duck
products.description: A little Swedish charm for your bathtub. Dala Duck enjoys a quiet fika and a thorough explanation of your latest coding problem. Coffee breaks are always welcome.

products.title: Duck You
products.description: Some days call for a duck with attitude. Duck You understands your frustration when nothing compiles. Take a breath, explain the problem and try again.

products.title: Gamer Duck
products.description: Your new player two has arrived. Gamer Duck is ready for late-night sessions, tricky puzzles and one more attempt at fixing that stubborn bug. No rage quitting.

products.title: Gamer Girl Duck
products.description: Meet your next teammate. Gamer Girl Duck brings confidence to every coding challenge and gaming session. Explain your strategy and get ready for the next level.

products.title: Groot Duck
products.description: A small friend with a big heart and a very limited vocabulary. Groot Duck listens while your ideas grow. Perfect company when you are branching out into new code.

products.title: Harry Ponder
products.description: Ponder your next spell with a magical desk companion. Harry Ponder cannot fix your code with a wand, but explaining the problem to him might work wonders.

products.title: Picasso Duck
products.description: See your problems from a different angle. Picasso Duck brings an artistic spirit to your desk and reminds you that a messy first draft can become something brilliant.

products.title: Pride Duck
products.description: Bring a splash of pride to your desk. Pride Duck celebrates being yourself and makes room for every idea. A cheerful companion for work, play and everything in between.

products.title: Queen Corgi Duck
products.description: Give your bathtub the royal treatment. Queen Corgi Duck expects excellent bubbles, regular tea breaks and a full report on your latest coding adventure.

products.title: Sonic Duck
products.description: Ready to race through your next adventure. Sonic Duck brings energy to your desk, but even he knows that slowing down to read an error message can save time.

products.title: Sphinx Duck
products.description: An ancient mystery meets the modern bathtub. Sphinx Duck guards your desk and silently challenges you to solve the riddle of your latest bug.

products.title: Tattoo Duck
products.description: A little ink and plenty of personality. Tattoo Duck brings a rebellious streak to your collection and listens without judging your questionable variable names.

products.title: Trump Duck
products.description: Campaigning for more bubbles and a bigger bathtub. Trump Duck brings political parody to your collection and has plenty of silent opinions about your code.

products.title: Turtles Duck
products.description: Pizza breaks and bathtub adventures await. Turtles Duck is ready to join your team, tackle tricky bugs and celebrate every small victory with another slice.
